decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed use of the existing building for residential purposes, with some commercial use, would result in the loss of employment use, contrary to policy E 1.5 of the Unitary Development Plan.
2.	The proposed scale, bulk and location of the ground floor extension is unacceptable in that it would result in a loss of outlook for surrounding residential properties, and a loss of amenity through increased noise and disturbance from the increased use of the enlarged property, contrary to policy ENV-B 1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan 
3.	The bulk, scale and use of the proposed extension would result in an unacceptable impact on the existing Grade 2 listed buildings of Arlington Cottages, and Turnham Green Conservation Area, and result in the loss of a neighbouring tree, contrary to policies ENV-B 2.2 and ENV-B 2.5 of the Unitary Development Plan  
4.	The use of the enlarged ground floor as an A4 unit in this area would cause an unacceptable amount of noise and disturbance and loss of amenity to residents all around the proposed site, contrary to policy ENV-B 1.1 and S 1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan 
5.	The increased size of the extension, together with the loss of rear servicing, would place pressure on on-street servicing, which is restricted in this part of Chiswick High Road, and this is likely to prejudice the free flow of traffic, in particular public transport, contrary to policy T 1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan
6.	The proposed development would create an unacceptable form of residential development, through inadequate layout, lack of amenity space, inadequate refuse and recycling arrangements and noise, contrary to policies ENV-P 1.5, ENV-B 1.1 and H 4.1 of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Refurbishment to existing B1 office building, extension and change of use of ground floor to A4 (pubs and bars), installation of external extract duct to side elevation, rear extension to first and second floors to create 6 X one bed units and two studio apartments with roof gardens to existing building
